title: Cal. Civ. Code § 1946.2 just cause eviction – operative date, waiver, mobilehome exemption
requirement: This just-cause eviction section may not be waived and bars enforcement of local ordinances less protective than it; it does not apply to a homeowner of a mobilehome. It became operative April 1, 2024, and is repealed as of January 1, 2030.
coverage_conditions: Applies to residential real property intended for human habitation, including units in a mobilehome park, but not to a homeowner of a mobilehome.
exemptions: Does not apply to a homeowner of a mobilehome, as defined in Section 798.9.
quoted_span:
(l) This section shall not apply to a homeowner of a mobilehome, as defined in Section 798.9.
(m) This section shall become operative on April 1, 2024.
interaction: A local ordinance enacted after September 1, 2019 that is less protective than this section is not to be enforced unless this section is repealed.
